How selling works.

Six steps from price update to keys. Most sales take 2 to 4 months in total.

  1. 1

    Day 1

    Price update

    Corey walks through your home and the sales around it, and gives you a realistic price range. Free, no obligation.

  2. 2

    Week 1

    Plan and sign

    Agree the price strategy, marketing and fees in writing. In Queensland that’s the Form 6 agency agreement.

  3. 3

    Weeks 1–2

    Get it ready

    Small fixes and styling advice, then professional photos, floor plan and video.

  4. 4

    Weeks 2–5

    Launch and open homes

    Live on realestate.com.au, Domain and NGU. Feedback after every open home, without you having to chase it.

  5. 5

    When offers arrive

    Offers and contract

    Corey negotiates, you decide. Once a contract is signed, the buyer usually has finance and building and pest conditions to meet.

  6. 6

    Usually 30–60 days after contract

    Settlement

    Corey keeps you updated until the keys are handed over.

Every sale is different. Timings are typical, not promised.

Privacy.

This website doesn’t store anything you type. When you send a form or tap Text or Email, your own email or messaging app opens with your message addressed to Corey Athanates at NGU Real Estate Brassall. Nothing is sent until you press send.

Corey uses your details only to reply about your enquiry. If you asked for the weekly open homes list, reply “stop” at any time.

To see, correct or remove the details Corey holds about you, call 0413 992 959 or email corey.a@ngurealestate.com.au.
